scope: Actual bounded scheduling-order allocation and ordered submission batches with producer continuation; epoch assignment and revoked-task replay; ReaderDone and request receipt root binding. Native capacity admission before WAL is covered by forced-boundary and isolated mutation regressions. Complete outer dispatch, mixed histories, caches and ownership remain open.

properties.queue_state::submission_result: Name the existing exact submission postcondition, preserving its identity/table error classification, unchanged errors, six-field task record and peer/root frames; the actual body is unchanged.
properties.queue_admin::{submit,submit_many,submitt: Checked consecutive order allocation for each supplied spec in order, including repeated IDs, and the precise successful prefix on error. Producer continuation follows complete task-batch success; producer failure retains that applied batch and counter.
properties.queue_admin::{has_capacity,capacity_rule: Exact order+count capacity predicate; a batch whose full count fits cannot fail with order exhaustion. Submission/yield check before their current task/reader mutations. Non-yielding progress and empty batches allocate no order.
properties.queue_admin::progress: Use the supplied yield flag and current order, preserve compound reader/task error prefixes, increment the counter only for a successful yield and return the same borrowed task ID.
properties.queue_admin::apply_epoch: Validate and assign the event epoch before revocation-array parsing and ordered retry effects, with exact epoch/state outcomes on every error.
properties.queue_admin::{remember,reader_done}: Bind request ledger updates and ordered reader releases to the correct queue root table and preserve all other roots; validate missing/wrong-shaped tables and retain exact ReaderDone error prefixes.

runtime_changes: Coordinator calls the verified administrative replay functions. New submission/yield capacity guards run after cached-response lookup and before retain/WAL writes. Checked increments replace unchecked +=1. The forced-capacity native fixture confirms ValueError without state/log changes or quarantine, and successful cached retry. Missing malformed replay tables return defined errors. No new I/O, persisted format, key allocation or trusted library primitive. The arithmetic checks run at runtime; performance has not been measured.
boundaries: Existing twenty audited serde primitives and String ordering/content abstractions remain unchanged. No new primitive, opaque type, Value law or admitted straw operation.

The counter bound is usize::MAX, matching the existing platform-sized internal counter. Ordinary progress and empty task batches remain allowed at that bound. This is defensive resource-boundary coverage, not a practical valid-workload overflow reproduction.
Native admission calls the verified capacity predicate and is tested before writes/after cached replies, but the complete native admission-to-event/WAL correspondence remains unproved.

Request-table postconditions use the existing receipt ledger/canonical-content abstraction, not exact JSON representation equality. Producer, epoch, batch and reader errors describe completed prefixes, not whole-event rollback.

Full event dispatch, sealed-state transition, ReaderRetired callback, mixed-event history, global scheduling-index/cache correspondence, root extraction, native quarantine/File/run/lock binding and cross-log/GC ownership remain unfinished.
